message: unknown effect `gx` in an effect argument

notes.message: to take the effects of the value passed in, declare `gx` on the function, after its name: `fn f[gx: Effects](x: T[gx]) uses (..., gx)` (core 6.2, decision 0522)
if `gx` is an effect variable, declare it on the function, after its name: `[gx: Effects]` (core 6.2, decision 0522)
